items.title: Korolivskyi Smak plant in Kirovohrad region destroyed following Russian strike
items.teaser: Korolivskyi Smak, a Ukrainian producer of sunflower oil and other food products, has permanently halted production after a Russian strike triggered a large-scale fire that destroyed the facility.

items.title: Magdeburg: Schwimmbecken im früheren Gerichtssaal muss mehrfach befüllt werden
items.teaser: In Magdeburg wird im früheren Anschlags-Gerichtsgebäude das Schwimmbecken gefüllt. Zuvor haben Lecks Probleme verursacht. Im Dezember soll der Betrieb starten.

items.title: UK announces US$316m air defence package for Ukraine
items.teaser: The UK government has announced a new £240 million military aid package to strengthen Ukraine's air defence capabilities this winter, including short-range missiles and launchers.

items.title: Finland denies entry to Russian figure skaters for Grand Prix stage
items.teaser: Russian athletes will miss the upcoming ISU figure skating competition in Helsinki after the Finnish authorities refused to allow them to cross the border.

items.title: Zerstörte Krim-Brücke: Was heißt das für Russland?
items.teaser: Die wichtige Krim-Brücke ist nach ukrainischen Angriffen teilweise eingestürzt. Was heißt das für die Versorgung der russisch besetzten Gebiete? Oberst Markus Reisner ordnet ein.

items.title: Xi, Trump, Putin - drei Präsidenten, drei Agenden
items.teaser: Zwei der drei Großnationen führen aktuell einen Krieg. Ob sie jetzt mit China ein Konzept für den Weltfrieden finden? Es war bisher nie leicht, dass die USA und China im Handelskonflikt einen gemeinsamen Nenner fanden.

items.title: Ukraine, Finland sign memorandum on joint defense production
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and Finnish Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen signed a memorandum on joint defense production during a meeting in Brussels.

items.title: UK anticipates "number of announcements" on weapons for Ukraine at Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting
items.teaser: A series of announcements on new military aid for Ukraine from its allies, including new UK air defence commitments, will be made at a meeting of the Ukraine Defence Contact Group (also known as the Ramstein format) in Brussels on 17 November.

items.title: NATO secretary general backs strikes on Crimean Bridge: "It is important that Ukraine defends itself"
items.teaser: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte says Ukraine has the right to defend itself, but notes that the exact circumstances of the strike on the Crimean Bridge have not been established yet.

items.title: Zahl der Verletzten nach russischem Angriff auf Saporischschja steigt auf 38, zwei Personen kamen ums Leben
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Verletzten nach einem russischen Angriff auf Saporischschja ist auf 38 angestiegen. Zwei Menschen wurden getötet, teilt der Co-Vorsitzende des Verteidigungsrats der Region Saporischschja, Iwan Fedorow, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Würde Kyjiw den Donbass für einen NATO-Beitritt aufgeben?
items.teaser: Die USA wollen wissen, ob die Ukraine im Gegenzug für einen NATO-Beitritt den von Russland nicht besetzten Teil des Gebiets Donezk räumen würde. Von der DW befragte Experten erläutern, warum diese Idee gefährlich ist.

items.title: Traffic partially resumed on Kyiv's Pivdennyi Bridge
items.teaser: Vehicles weighing up to 10 tonnes and public transport up to 18 tonnes can use the bridge towards the right bank. Traffic in the opposite direction remains closed.

items.title: Ukraine harvests 68.2 Mt of grain and oilseed crops
items.teaser: As of November 17, Ukrainian farmers had harvested 50.1 million tonnes of grain crops, including 26.26 million tonnes of wheat, as well as 18.1 million tonnes of oilseed crops.

items.title: Monument to North Korean soldiers who fought against Ukraine appears in Kursk
items.teaser: Local authorities in the Russian city of Kursk have installed a sculpture to commemorate DPRK military personnel who fought in the war against Ukraine, though it is currently under a protective film.

items.title: Amount of FIFA and UEFA payments to Russia since full-scale invasion revealed
items.teaser: An investigation by British media indicates that global football governing bodies have allocated over £45 million to the aggressor state's football association since early 2022.

items.title: Zelensky announces Berlin talks with US, European allies to shape next phase of Russia negotiations
items.teaser: The Berlin meeting could take place on Nov. 19, a Ukrainian official told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: APEC summit: What Trump, Xi and Putin want
items.teaser: Trump, Xi and Putin will hold their first trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC. With different priorities on trade, Ukraine, Iran and arms control, what does each leader hope to gain?

items.title: Generalstab bestätigt Treffer auf Gazprom-Anlage in Baschkortostan
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf den 17. November haben die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte eine große Gazprom-Raffinerie in der russischen Republik Baschkortostan getroffen – etwa 1500 Kilometer von der ukrainischen Grenze entfernt, teilt der Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Zelenskyy outlines preparation for major prisoner swap: intelligence agencies in contact
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president has stated that Kyiv will hand over its proposals for an exchange of prisoners of war to Washington following recent agreements reached in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Once shunned, Poland's Ukraine-bashing firebrand sees political breakthrough
items.teaser: Once too extreme even for Polish conservatives, far-right firebrand Grzegorz Braun is now being courted by leading right-wing politicians as they seek to unite ahead of the 2027 elections. Braun, a Moscow-friendly provocateur facing multiple charges for his antisemitic, anti-LGBT, and anti-Ukrainian stunts, leads the C

items.title: EU to assist Ukraine in developing customs IT systems
items.teaser: The European Union will provide Ukraine with expert, financial and technical support through October 2029 to develop the customs IT systems required for the country's accession to the EU.

items.title: Grain carrier Betul 8 capsizes off Bulgaria with wheat for Egypt, likely hit by Russian sea drones, ISW says
items.teaser: A Bulgarian maritime outlet says the drones looked like the type that sank a container ship off the same coast last month.

items.title: Ukraine greift erneut Krim-Brücke an
items.teaser: Ukraine greift erneut Krim-Brücke an

items.title: Axios: Witkoff, Kushner to meet Ukrainian, EU officials to discuss peace plan
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are planning to meet with Ukrainian and European officials this week to discuss security guarantees and a plan for Ukraine's postwar economic recovery.

items.title: Teheran "ist nun mal verrückt": Trump nimmt Bedrohung durch schmutzige Bombe "sehr ernst"
items.teaser: US-Geheimdienste befürchten einem Medienbericht zufolge, dass radioaktives Material in die Vereinigten Staaten gelangt sein könnte. Im Raum steht ein möglicher Anschlagsplan in Washington. Präsident Trump spricht von einer sehr ernsten Bedrohung und richtet eine scharfe Warnung an Teheran.

items.title: Missile-drones, cruise missiles, and a Flamingo guided to the last second: Kyiv’s account of the night Russia’s Kerch bridge lost its road
items.teaser: The guidance link held to the last seconds, Zelenskyy says, while the SBU says its Palianytsia missile-drones sent the road span into the water.

items.title: BTA Bank to rebrand as NovaBank
items.teaser: NOVA Group has completed its acquisition of JSC BTA Bank and is moving ahead with its integration with NovaPay, paving the way for operations under the NovaBank brand.

items.title: Train collision in Czechia: 15 Ukrainian citizens among those injured
items.teaser: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry says 15 Ukrainian citizens were among 46 people who suffered minor injuries when two trains collided near Prague's main railway station.

items.title: New EU funding rules to protect sports from Russian influence, visa ban in the works
items.teaser: "With EU taxpayers' money ... we will not, of course, support and finance participants that are connected to the types of symbolism of violence and aggression," EU Commissioner Roxana Minzatu said.

items.title: Anschlag in London: „Zünde ihn an“, sagte er auf FaceTime
items.teaser: Der Iran setzt im Konflikt mit den USA und Israel offenbar auf eine neue Strategie: Über kriminelle Netzwerke organisiert Teheran Anschläge auf Synagogen und US-Einrichtungen in Europa.

items.title: Luftwaffe wehrt drei russische gelenkte Fliegerbomben, drei Banderol - Marschflugkörper und 205 Drohnen ab
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge drei gelenkte Fliegerbomben vom Typ Ch-59/Ch-69, drei Banderol/ Dan-Т- Marschflugkörper und 205 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine seit Abend des 16. November angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: Russia says it will rebuild Crimean Bridge 'even better.' Here's why they'll be disappointed
items.teaser: Russia has vowed to restore the Crimean Bridge after Ukrainian drones and missiles struck the structure on Nov. 17, collapsing a major section of its roadway, but experts told the Kyiv Independent that repairs could take a year or more and require significant resources. The bridge is a key logistics

items.title: Dutch company withdraws lawsuit against Ukraine’s honorary consul in Netherlands over alleged ties to Russia
items.teaser: Dutch company Peja Group has withdrawn an urgent court application against Karel Burger Dirven, Honorary Consul of Ukraine in the Netherlands, whom it accused of allegedly making defamatory statements about its business ties with Russia.

items.title: Deutschland kauft neue Flugabwehrraketen für Ukraine
items.teaser: Der Ukraine droht angesichts massiver russischer Angriffe ein harter Winter. Die Bundesregierung will Kiew helfen - vor allem bei der Flugabwehr. Sie kauft dafür Waffen aus den USA.

items.title: Ukrainian vegetable oil company reports massive destruction and colossal losses following attack
items.teaser: The Viktor & K company, which produces food under the Korolivskyi Smak brand, has been forced to completely suspend production after a Russian strike caused extensive damage and one fatality.

items.title: Russland plant Aneignung von über tausend Häusern in besetzten Teilen der Region Cherson – Geheimdienst
items.teaser: Russland bereitet die sogenannte „Nationalisierung“ von über 1.100 Wohnhäusern ukrainischer Staatsbürger in den vorübergehend besetzten Teilen der Region Cherson vor.

items.title: Ukraine’s air defense neutralizes three Russian missiles, three Banderols, 205 drones
items.teaser: As of 12:00 on Tuesday, November 17, Ukraine's air defense forces had neutralized three Kh-59/Kh-69 guided aerial missiles, three S8000 Banderol/Dan-T missiles and 205 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 16.

items.title: Anti-Corruption Bureau director says second Operation Carthage brought too many enemies
items.teaser: The heads of Ukraine's anti-corruption bodies have warned of various information operations aimed at undermining public trust in the Specialised Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) and the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) in connection with the investigations into the Carthage case.

items.title: Verteidigungsministerium: Angriff auf Kertsch-Brücke ausschließlich mit ukrainischen Waffen durchgeführt
items.teaser: Das Verteidigungsministerium der Ukraine betonte auf Facebook, dass bei der mehrstufigen Operation zur Zerstörung der Kertsch-Brücke ausschließlich ukrainische Waffen zum Einsatz kamen.

items.title: General Staff confirms strike on Gazprom oil refinery in Bashkortostan
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat facility in Russia's Bashkortostan overnight on November 17, approximately 1,500 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.

items.title: Rescuers spent 14 days searching the ruins of a Ukrainian aid hub where Russia killed 72 people, and four more are still missing
items.teaser: Russia kept striking the site while crews dug, and DNA tests confirmed some of the deaths.

items.title: Trump wants one-on-one meeting with Putin
items.teaser: The US president has revealed his willingness to hold direct bilateral talks with the Russian leader in Shenzhen, alongside their scheduled trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping.

items.title: Selenskyj: „Paljanyzja“ traf Autoteil der Kertsch-Brücke, „Neptun“, „Ruta“ und FP-5 Eisenbahnstrecke
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj gab heute auf Facebook Details zur Operation gegen die Kertsch-Brücke bekannt. Laut seinen Angaben umfasste sie sieben Etappen, die über mehrere Wochen durchgeführt wurden.

items.title: Russian drone strikes police vehicle in Sumy region, two officers injured
items.teaser: Two police officers were injured when a Russian drone struck a police vehicle in the town of Hlukhiv, Shostka district, Sumy region.

items.title: Hungary suspends rail services to Ukraine due to Russian attacks
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has announced the Hungarian government's decision to suspend rail services to Ukraine on Tuesday 17 November and Wednesday 18 November due to Russian attacks on Zakarpattia Oblast.

items.title: Selenskyj bestätigt teilweise Zerstörung der Krim-Brücke
items.teaser: Das ukrainische Militär hat offenbar einen Teil der Krim-Brücke zerstört. Fotos und Videos zeigen, dass einer der beiden Brückenbögen eingestürzt ist. Die Verbindung auf die Krim war stets ein Prestigeprojekt Putins.

items.title: Air defence downs 3 missiles and over 200 Russian drones: Impacts recorded at 44 locations
items.teaser: Starting on the evening of 16 November, Russia launched over 300 UAVs alongside ballistic and cruise missiles against Ukraine, with air defences downing 205 drones and three missiles while impacts struck 44 sites.

items.title: 7th Air Assault Corps Commander Lasiichuk: If Pokrovsk had simply let the Russians through, Dobropillia would no longer exist
USF commander shows drones used in strike on Crimean Bridge
items.teaser: Robert Brovdi, commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, has shown the drones used in the strike on the Kerch Strait Bridge.

items.title: Einer der größten russischen Petrochemiekomplexe in Baschkortostan nach Angriff in Flammen
items.teaser: In Baschkortostan, Russland, wurde einer der größten russischen Petrochemiekomplexe, Gazprom Neftechim Salavat, angegriffen.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Russia-Crimea bridge appears destroyed after strike
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said a strike on the Kerch bridge in Crimea was in response to continued Russian attacks targeting his country's infrastructure. Meanwhile, two bridges were hit in Russian attacks on Kyiv. DW has more.

items.title: Arch and road span collapse: General Staff confirms results of strike on Kerch Bridge
items.teaser: The arch and a span of the road section of the Kerch Strait Bridge collapsed following a strike by Ukraine's Defense Forces overnight on November 17.

items.title: Zwei Tote, ein Verletzter bei russischem Angriff auf Kyjiw
items.teaser: Beim russischen Raketen- und Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw am 17. November wurden zwei Menschen getötet und ein weiterer verletzt.

items.title: Moskau beruft Krisensitzung nach Angriff auf Krim-Brücke ein
items.teaser: Die Folgen der ukrainischen Attacke müssten bewältigt werden, heißt es kurz vor der von Vize-Regierungschef Marat Chusnullin geleiteten Sondersitzung. In Agenturberichten ist von schweren Schäden an der Brücke die Rede.

items.title: Families with children ordered to evacuate from Balabyne in Zaporizhzhia region
items.teaser: Families with children have been ordered to evacuate from the settlement of Balabyne, near Zaporizhzhia, under an order issued by the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration.

items.title: Russian forces strike Mukachevo in Zakarpattia region
items.teaser: The Russian military attacked the city of Mukachevo in Ukraine’s western Zakarpattia region on November 17.

items.title: Verstoß gegen Kriegswaffengesetz: Polizei durchsucht Haus von Ibrahim Ibrahims Sohn
items.teaser: Die Berliner Staatsanwaltschaft bestätigt eine Hausdurchsuchung bei dem Sohn des Anti-Israel-Aktivisten und Terror-Unterstützers Ibrahim Ibrahim.

items.title: Einer der Bögen der Krim-Brücke beim erneuten Angriff beschädigt
items.teaser: Einer der beiden Brückenbögen der Krim-Brücke wurde bei einem Angriff beschädigt.

items.title: Germany to contribute $300M to new PURL package with Patriot missiles – Pistorius
items.teaser: Germany will contribute $300 million to a new package of U.S. weapons purchases for Ukraine under the PURL initiative, jointly funded with Norway. The package will focus primarily on strengthening Ukraine’s air defenses by providing missiles for Patriot systems.

items.title: Palianytsia struck road section of Crimean Bridge, Neptune, Ruta, and FP-5 hit rail section - Zelensky
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has revealed details of the operation targeting the Crimean Bridge, saying it consisted of seven stages carried out over several weeks.

items.title: Russia opposes separate Black Sea deal without a peace agreement, Turkish FM says
items.teaser: Russia does not want to reach an interim agreement with Ukraine on the Black Sea without a comprehensive peace deal. Turkey is working on proposals to facilitate an agreement and discussing them with both the Ukrainian and Russian sides.

items.title: An der Front 135 Stürme gemeldet, Russen machen Druck in Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: An der Front kam es am vergangenen Tag, dem 16. November, zu 135 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Streitkräften und den russischen Besatzern, ließ auf Facebook der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte zur Lage an der Front am Dienstag, dem 17. November, melden.

items.title: Russian strike cuts power to more than 300 settlements in Rivne region
items.teaser: More than 300 settlements in the Rivne region have been left without electricity following a Russian attack this morning.

items.title: Emergency power outages affect four regions following Russian attacks
items.teaser: Emergency power outages have been introduced in the Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Poltava, and Kharkiv regions due to equipment damage and a drop in voltage in the high-voltage grid following Russian attacks.

items.title: The night the Kerch Bridge lost its road arch, Ukraine’s drones also reached Bashkortostan and Kursk
items.teaser: Russia claimed more than 1,400 drones downed overnight, in what Russian Telegram channel Astra called the largest such attack.

items.title: Russia hit a Zaporizhzhia bridge, then Kyiv’s bridges by midnight—civilians died in both cities
items.teaser: Specialists are still inspecting Kyiv's damaged bridges, and the city will know when it can reopen them only after their findings, the mayor says.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Saporischschja tötet zwei und verletzt 18 Menschen
items.teaser: In der Stadt Saporischschja ist die Zahl der Verletzten infolge des russischen Angriffs am Morgen auf 18 gestiegen. Zudem wurde von einem weiteren Toten bekannt.

items.teaser: Visualize this: You are sitting in an arbitration hearing. Your legal team has successfully proven a breach of contract in a massive cross-border joint venture. items.title: Russen töten einen und verletzen neun Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 16. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk einen Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Interview: Lithuania's foreign minister says Europe needs to 'just ignore' Russia's demands and stay focused
items.teaser: BRUSSELS, Belgium — Europe needs to not fall for Russia's traps in peace negotiations and stay focused on how to achieve a ceasefire in Ukraine, Lithuania's Foreign Minister Kestutis Budrys told the Kyiv Independent in an interview on Nov. 16. Russia has revived impossible demands to

items.title: Mit schmutziger Bombe - Iran soll Anschlag in Washington planen
items.teaser: US-Geheimdienste warnen vor konkreten Plänen für einen Angriff auf die Trump-Regierung.

items.title: Russian attack on Kyiv kills two, injures one
items.teaser: Two people were killed and another was injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv on November 17.

items.title: Ukraine should join NATO, must not give up territory in exchange, Estonian DM says
items.teaser: Estonian Defense Minister General Martin Herem has said that Ukraine should not have to give up any of its territory in exchange for NATO membership.

items.title: Two killed and 18 injured in Russian attack on industrial facilities in Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: Following deadly drone strikes the previous evening, a combined Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia's industrial and energy infrastructure on 17 November left two people killed, 18 injured and widespread power outages

items.title: One arch left standing: Ukraine’s second strike in two days sends the road span of Russia’s Kerch bridge into the sea
items.teaser: Morning photos show the rail arch alone over the shipping channel of the bridge Russia built illegally to occupied Crimea.

items.title: Nord- und Süd-Brücken in Kyjiw werden auf Schäden nach russischem Angriff untersucht, Verkehr gesperrt – Klitschko
items.teaser: In Kyjiw untersuchen die Fachleute die Nord- und Süd-Brücke, die durch den russischen Raketenangriff vom 17. November beschädigt wurden.

items.title: Fire breaks out at a petrochemical complex after attack in Russia’s Bashkortostan – media
items.teaser: Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat, one of Russia’s largest petrochemical complexes, was targeted in an attack in the Republic of Bashkortostan.

items.title: IMF notes progress on structural benchmarks required for US$1.6 billion tranche
items.teaser: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) mission and the Ukrainian authorities have made significant progress in agreeing on the commitments needed to reach a staff-level agreement on the second and third reviews of the four-year US$8.1 billion Extended Fund Facility (EFF) programme.

items.title: Death toll from attack on Chernihiv rises to three – photos
items.teaser: Chernihiv Oblast Governor Viacheslav Chaus has confirmed a third man died in hospital on Tuesday following Russia's 16 November Banderol missile strike on businesses and garages in Chernihiv.

items.title: Russian missile strike on Smila damages industrial facilities, injures six
items.teaser: A Russian missile attack on Smila, Cherkasy region, damaged industrial infrastructure and a vocational education institution, injuring six people. Hourly power outage schedules have also been temporarily suspended in Uman district.

items.title: In Region Charkiw werden Menschen aus 96 Ortschaften evakuiert
items.teaser: In Region Charkiw werden Menschen aktiv aus 96 Siedlungen evakuiert.

items.title: Russians attack Odesa Oblast, damaging energy facility, warehouses and student accommodation, one injured
items.teaser: One person was injured in a Russian attack on southern Odesa Oblast on 17 November. An energy facility, office building, student accommodation, warehouse and lorries were damaged, with power outages affecting two cities

items.title: In Region Cherson ein Zivilist getötet, drei verletzt, 34 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 34 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurde ein Zivilist getötet, drei weitere verletzt.

items.title: Kyiv’s Northern and Southern Bridges remain closed as experts assess damage from Russian attack – Klitschko
items.teaser: Experts are assessing damage to Kyiv’s Northern and Southern bridges caused by a Russian missile attack in the early hours of November 17.

items.title: Russian attack on industrial facilities in Zaporizhzhia kills one, injures nine
items.teaser: One man was killed and nine people were injured in a Russian attack on industrial facilities in Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Russia claims it shot down a record number of Ukrainian drones overnight
items.teaser: Russian authorities report 1,441 drones downed overnight on 16-17 November – including 321 approaching Moscow – amid renewed strikes on the Crimean Bridge and Bashkortostan's Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat facility.

items.title: Overnight Russian attack on Kyiv: Klitschko shows damage to Pivnichnyi Bridge
items.teaser: Engineers are assessing the damage to Kyiv's Pivnichnyi and Pivdennyi bridges following overnight Russian strikes. Mayor Vitali Klitschko says a decision on reopening them will depend on the inspection results.

items.title: 317 Buildings in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi District left without heating after Russian attack
items.teaser: A total of 317 residential buildings in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district remain without heating in the aftermath of a Russian attack.

items.title: Russland plant Steigerung der Raketenproduktion und erhält monatlich ballistische Raketen aus Nordkorea – Selenskyj
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte gestern Abend in seiner Videoansprache, dass er vom Militärnachrichtendienst Informationen über Russlands Pläne zur Steigerung der Produktion ballistischer Raketen und Marschflugkörper erhalten habe. Zudem erhalte die Russische Föderation monatlich Dutzende ballistische Raketen au

items.title: One of Crimean Bridge’s arches damaged in second strike
items.teaser: One of the two arches of the Crimean Bridge was damaged in a second attack in as many days, media reports say.

items.title: War update: 135 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: On November 16, a total of 135 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the frontline.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 55 Ortschaften beschossen, vier Zivilisten getötet, acht verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 55 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 864 Mal.

items.title: Crimean Bridge arch collapses into sea after attack, all traffic suspended – photo, video
items.teaser: One of the Crimean Bridge's arches and part of its roadway have fallen into the sea following another attack. Russia's Transport Ministry has confirmed that all traffic across the bridge has been suspended.

items.title: Russian shelling reported in four Kyiv districts, one person injured
items.teaser: The consequences of Russian attacks on Kyiv on November 17 have been recorded in four districts: Holosiivskyi, Desnianskyi, Dniprovskyi and Obolonskyi.

items.title: Angriffe auf die Ukraine: Zwei wichtige Brücken in Kiew getroffen
items.teaser: Trotz US-Vermittlungen gehen die Angriffe weiter: Russland meldet einen Angriff auf die Krim-Brücke, auch in Kiew wurden zwei Brücken getroffen. In der Region Saporischschja sind die Rettungsarbeiten nach einem der folgenschwersten Angriffe beendet.

items.title: Ukrainian ambassador to France meets Le Pen to discuss support for Kyiv
items.teaser: Vadym Omelchenko met Marine Le Pen to discuss Ukraine's EU and NATO aspirations, defence cooperation and postwar reconstruction. Le Pen reiterated her position on financial and military assistance to Kyiv

items.title: Russian army loses another 1,620 personnel, four MLRS in Ukraine
items.teaser: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to November 17, 2026, have reached approximately 1,627,040 personnel, including 1,620 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Overnight Russian attack on Kyiv: infrastructure and bridges damaged, water and heating disrupted, one injured
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Kyiv on 17 November caused fires in four districts, damaged two major bridges and left 317 residential buildings without heating. A 34-year-old man was hospitalised.

items.title: Weitere hohe Kampfverluste der Russen - 1620 Soldaten am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 17. November 2026 werden auf etwa 1.627040 (+1620 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Car driver killed in drone attack on Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: A car driver was killed in a drone attack on the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Oil refinery in Bashkortostan attacked again, 1,300 km from Ukrainian border
items.teaser: Explosions and a fire have been reported at the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat complex, approximately 1,300 km from Ukraine's border. The facility was recently sanctioned by the EU and has been targeted in previous attacks.

items.title: Traffic suspended on Kyiv's Northern and Southern bridges following Russian attacks
items.teaser: Traffic on Kyiv's Northern and Southern bridges has been temporarily suspended following Russian attacks on the capital, and public transport routes have been diverted.

items.title: Woman rescued from rubble of damaged industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: A woman has been rescued from the rubble of a damaged industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia. Her condition is stable.

items.title: Russia loses 1,620 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,620 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Military evacuate last resident from village in Sumy region
items.teaser: Ukrainian troops have evacuated the last remaining resident of the village of Kyianytsia in the Sumy region.

items.title: Traffic on Kyiv's Pivnichnyi and Pivdennyi bridges suspended following Russian strikes
items.teaser: Russian missile attacks on Kyiv have forced the temporary closure of the Pivnichnyi and Pivdennyi bridges, disrupted several trolleybus routes and suspended metro services on part of the green line.

items.title: Evacuation continues in 96 settlements in Kharkiv region
items.teaser: The evacuation of residents from 96 settlements in the Kharkiv region is ongoing.

items.title: Fire reported at major Russian petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan amid drone attack
items.teaser: Photos and videos circulated by the channels purportedly show a large glow from a fire near the industrial facility. Exilenova+ reported fires at multiple locations within the complex, although the extent of any damage remains unclear.

items.title: Kyiv metro's above-ground infrastructure damaged in Russian attack, Green Line services suspended
items.teaser: Kyiv's metro infrastructure above ground was damaged in a Russian attack, temporarily suspending train services on the Green Line.

items.title: Peace plan: Trump's envoys will meet European and Ukrainian officials in Berlin – Axios
items.teaser: Donald Trump's envoys are planning talks with Ukrainian and European officials on Thursday to develop postwar security arrangements and economic recovery plans, alongside US diplomatic efforts involving Russia.

items.title: Ukraine trifft russische Raffinerien und Exporthafen
items.teaser: Die Ukraine setzt Russlands Ölsektor deutlich unter Druck. Innerhalb von einer Woche wurden neun der 35 großen Raffinerien getroffen oder im Betrieb gestört.

items.title: Scheduled power outages to affect some regions of Ukraine on Tuesday
items.teaser: Scheduled electricity outages will be in effect around the clock in some regions of Ukraine on Tuesday, November 17.

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Erste Vorgespräche mit Europas Unterhändlern
items.teaser: Europäische Unterhändler haben erste Vorgespräche mit den USA und der Ukraine über eine Beendigung des Kriegs geführt - und dabei die Vertreter instruiert, die später mit Russland verhandeln.

items.title: South Korea scrambles fighter jets after Russian military aircraft enter air defense zone
items.teaser: South Korea's military detected the Russian aircraft before they entered the zone and deployed fighter jets as a precaution against possible incidents, the JCS said.

items.title: Sixteen people evacuated from temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine
items.teaser: Sixteen Ukrainians have been evacuated from temporarily occupied territories, most of them elderly people. The oldest evacuee is 86.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Key bridges in Kyiv, Crimea hit in strikes
items.teaser: Kyiv's mayor said Russian forces have hit bridges on the Dnipro River. Ukraine launched a massive attack on Russia earlier on Monday, hitting the Crimean Bridge. DW has the latest.

items.title: Estonia plans to send over 70 locomotives to Ukraine, first deliveries possible this year
items.teaser: The initiative could eventually deliver more than 70 locomotives, although the final number and delivery arrangements have not yet been determined.

items.title: Import duty exemptions reach UAH 39B in October
items.teaser: Customs duty exemptions granted on imported goods totaled UAH 39 billion in October 2026, equivalent to 51.6% of customs revenues paid into the state budget, which reached UAH 75.4 billion during the month.

items.title: Electrical substation on fire in Russia's Kursk following attack – video
items.teaser: Local reports and Astra analysis have confirmed a fire at the 330 kV Sadovaya substation in northern Kursk after midnight explosions, impacting a critical grid hub serving 400,000 people.

items.title: Ukrainian forces reportedly strike Crimean Bridge after Russian missiles hit Kyiv bridges
items.teaser: The attack came shortly after Russian forces launched a massive ballistic missile attack across Ukraine and hit the Northern and Southern Bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv.

items.title: Russia redeploys strategic bombers to protect them from attacks – Ukrainian Air Force
items.teaser: Russia is redeploying its strategic bombers, particularly following Ukrainian strikes on military airfields, in an effort to protect its aircraft from further attacks.

items.title: New trade-restrictive measures surge but WTO members step up trade facilitation efforts
items.teaser: The pace of newly-introduced tariffs and other non-facilitating measures rose sharply in the first half of 2026, while the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO Director-General's latest annual overview of developments in the international trading environment. items.title: European foreign ministers call on EU to crack down on Russian crypto networks
items.teaser: “Our sanctions against Russia must hold even when money finds new ways to move," said Finnish Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen. "We must stop war cryptos and squeeze Russia’s war chest with new targeted sanctions and enhanced international cooperation.”

items.title: Russia claims 800 drones attacked Moscow and Moscow Oblast
items.teaser: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin has claimed around 800 UAVs flew toward Moscow Oblast between 16 and 17 November, with 321 downed near the capital and operations suspended at all four Moscow airports

items.title: Elina Svitolina finishes as runner-up at 2026 WTA Finals
items.teaser: The 2026 WTA Finals, the season-ending tournament of the Women's Tennis Association, has concluded in Indian Wells, USA.

items.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again – photo, video
items.teaser: Russian-installed officials in Crimea say the Crimean Bridge has come under another attack. Reports indicate that one of its arches has been damaged, with the bridge deck deformed and traffic suspended.

items.title: Washington joins Empty Chairs action in support of Ukrainian journalists detained by Russia
items.teaser: The Embassy of Ukraine in the United States joined the international Empty Chairs action in support of Ukrainian journalists, writers and human rights defenders illegally detained by Russia.

items.title: Three injured in Russian ballistic missile attacks on Smila in Cherkasy Oblast
items.teaser: Early reports from Cherkasy Oblast Military Administration head Ihor Taburets has confirmed three injuries after Russian forces targeted Smila with ballistic missiles in the middle of the night on 16-17 November.

items.title: Key bridges in Kyiv struck in massive Russian ballistic missile attack across Ukraine
items.teaser: "Preliminary reports indicate that there were impacts on the North and South bridges in the capital city," Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.

items.title: Russians strike industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia and blow up car with drone, killing driver
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia on Monday evening, striking critical infrastructure and hitting a car with an FPV drone. The driver was killed, while a woman was rescued from the site of an industrial facility strike.

items.title: War update: 133 combat engagements on front line
items.teaser: There have been 133 combat engagements along the front line. In the Pokrovsk sector, Russian forces attacked Ukrainian Defense Forces positions 13 times, losing nearly 70 personnel.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Zelensky warns of imminent Russian attacks, 'extremely dangerous' North Korean missile development
items.teaser: "Please, be sure to heed air-raid alerts this evening, tonight, and throughout the day tomorrow," Zelensky warned Ukrainians. "There is information that the Russians have prepared for an attack." Zelensky also said North Korea is now supplying Moscow with dozens of ballistic missiles each month.

items.title: Russian drone strikes residential area in Sumy, two people injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a residential house with an FPV drone in the Stetskivskyi district of Sumy, where residents, including children, were present.

items.title: Putin mentions North Korean troops' role in Kursk during meeting with Kim Jong Un’s aide
items.teaser: Vladimir Putin has acknowledged the involvement of North Korean soldiers in battles in Kursk Oblast during a meeting with a senior North Korean official and announced plans for a monument honouring Russian and Korean troops.

items.title: Emergency power outages introduced in Uman district following Russian attack
items.teaser: Parts of the Uman district in the Cherkasy region have been left without electricity following a Russian attack.

items.title: Trump's envoy Kushner: Any final peace agreement must be agreed by both Russia and Ukraine
items.teaser: Jared Kushner says US-led negotiations are producing constructive ideas despite remaining differences, stressing that a lasting agreement to end the war will require difficult decisions and coordination with Ukraine, Russia and Europe.

items.title: Russian attack cuts power to 76 settlements in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure in the Mykolaiv region on Monday evening, leaving 76 settlements in the Pervomaiskyi district without electricity.

items.title: A new defense for Ukraine's corruption suspects: Anti-graft probes help Russia at the negotiating table
items.teaser: Several former and current senior Ukrainian officials facing corruption investigations have promoted a similar narrative over the past week. items.title: Anbieter benötigen Lizenz: USA verschärfen Exportkontrollen für Nvidia-Chips
items.teaser: Nach dem Skandal um mögliche chinesische Spionage beim US-Chipentwickler Nvidia erlässt das US-Handelsministerium neue Vorschriften. Diese sollen verhindern, dass chinesische Unternehmen die hochmodernen US-Chips von Drittländern nutzen.

items.title: Russia plans to increase missile production, receives ballistic missiles from North Korea every month – Zelensky
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said he had received intelligence from Ukraine's Defense Intelligence Directorate (HUR) indicating that Russia plans to increase production of ballistic and cruise missiles. He also said Russia receives dozens of ballistic missiles from North Korea every month.

items.title: Komyshuvakha rescue operations cease two weeks after Russian strike, 72 dead, 4 still missing
items.teaser: "Unfortunately, the shelling of Komyshuvakha on November 2, 2026, was one of the most tragic events during the full-scale war," Ukraine's Internal Affairs Minister Ivan Vyhivskyi said. "Eternal memory to all those who died as a result of this brutal attack."

items.title: Search and rescue operations completed in Komyshuvakha, death toll rises to 72
items.teaser: The death toll from the Russian attack on Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region on November 2 has risen to 72. Search and rescue operations have been completed, while four people remain missing.

items.title: Verfassungsschutz sieht Thüringen unter Druck
items.teaser: In Thüringen nimmt die Zahl der Reichsbürger und gewaltorientierten Rechtsextremen zu. Die Hemmschwelle für schwere Straftaten sinkt. Der Verfassungsschutz sieht den Freistaat massiv unter Druck.

items.title: Zelensky urges Ukrainians to heed air raid alerts, says Russia prepares new attack
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said people should pay close attention to air raid alerts tonight and throughout the day tomorrow, as there is information indicating that Russia is preparing an attack.

items.title: Korezkyj bespricht mit Kallas Verschärfung von Sanktionen gegen Russland
items.teaser: Der Ministerpräsident der Ukraine, Serhij Korezkyj hat bei einem Treffen mit der Hohen Vertreterin der EU für Außen- und Sicherheitspolitik, Kaja Kallas in Brüssel eine Verschärfung von Sanktionen gegen Russland besprochen.

items.title: US envoy Kushner says preparations are underway for multilateral meeting on war in Ukraine
items.teaser: The US envoy says he and Steve Witkoff discussed next steps with Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov and held a separate call with Ukrainian and European representatives.

items.title: Russian forces attack Zaporizhzhia, woman injured
items.teaser: A woman was injured in a Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Crimean Bridge hit in reported attack, traffic restrictions imposed
items.teaser: Key developments on November 16: Crimean Bridge hit in reported attack, traffic restrictions imposed Record number of Ukrainian drones launched at Russia, Moscow Oblast among main targets Russia could launch 6,500 jet-powered Shahed-type drones at Ukraine in November, PM says Ukraine strikes key oil refinery in souther

items.title: Ukraine: Vorbereitung auf Kriegswinter nach Angriffen auf Energieinfrastruktur
items.teaser: Ukraine: Vorbereitung auf Kriegswinter nach Angriffen auf Energieinfrastruktur

items.title: Cargo ship sinks in Bulgaria's Black Sea after reported drone attack, all 12 crew rescued
items.teaser: Commercial shipping in the Black Sea has faced a growing number of drone attacks in recent months, threatening a key route for grain and other goods. Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha warned that disruptions to maritime routes could drive global food prices up by as much as 25%, hitting poorer countries hardest.

items.title: Drone attack: Fire extinguished in courtyard of Kyiv apartment building
items.teaser: Firefighters have extinguished a blaze that broke out in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district after debris from a Russian drone fell there.

items.title: Komyshuvakha search operation completed: Russian attack killed 72 people – photos
items.teaser: Two weeks of search operations after Russian guided bombs hit a humanitarian hub on 2 November have ended. Four people are still missing.

items.title: Brandsätze, Drohnen und Agenten: Wie der Schattenkrieg Russland erfasst
items.teaser: Mysteriöse Brände, entgleiste Züge, zerschnittene Kabel: In den vergangenen Monaten häufen sich die Berichte über angebliche Sabotage-Aktionen im russischen Hinterland. Daten eines internationalen OSINT-Projekts deuten auf zunehmende Aktivitäten russischer Untergrundgruppen hin.

items.title: Kremlin says Russia was not consulted on Europe's involvement in peace talks
items.teaser: Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov says Moscow has not approved the expansion of the trilateral format and wants Europe to present constructive proposals before its involvement is discussed.

items.title: Zelenskyy reports on "difficult" team-level Ukraine-US-Europe talks
items.teaser: Negotiators from Ukraine, the US and five European countries discussed the peace process on 16 November, agreeing to meet in Berlin to work out joint steps.

items.title: 3D-printing-based production: JATEC launches project for Ukraine's unmanned systems
items.teaser: The NATO-Ukraine Joint Analysis, Training and Education Centre (JATEC) is implementing a project to develop additive manufacturing systems for unmanned aerial vehicles.

items.title: Exclusive: Sale of Ukraine’s Sense Bank faces yearlong delay despite interest from major banks
items.teaser: Following a corruption probe into Sense Bank in August, which implicated CEO Oleksii Stupak, officials pushed the Finance Ministry and the National Bank of Ukraine to speed up the sale.

items.title: Außenminister: mehr als 1600 Hafenanlagen und über 260 Schiffe infolge russischer Aggression beschädigt
items.teaser: Russlands Aggression stellt ernsthafte Bedrohungen für internationale Handelsrouten und die kritische Infrastruktur in der Schwarzmeerregion dar. items.title: EU's top diplomat: EU may obtain lists of Russians who have fought against Ukraine to implement entry ban
items.teaser: Kaja Kallas said the EU could bar Russians who fought in Ukraine as part of its 22nd sanctions package, using intelligence data, though some states question how this would work in practice.

items.title: Le Pen wants to end Ukraine financial aid if elected
items.teaser: Le Pen is leading the polls for France's April 2027 presidential election, and her stance on Ukraine and Russia has already become a key campaign issue for her and her competitors.

items.title: Thüringer Verfassungsschutz meldet mehr hybride Angriffe
items.teaser: Auch das Bundesland Thüringen ist mittlerweile Ziel sogenannter hybrider Angriffe. Der neue Verfassungsschutzbericht zeigt, dass die Behörden mit immer mehr Bedrohungslagen umgehen müssen. Axel Hemmerling erläutert.

items.title: Four people killed in explosion in Kyiv region's Brovary district
items.teaser: Four people, including a serviceman and a teenage girl, were killed in an explosion in the village of Mala Berezanka in the Brovary district, Kyiv region. A pre-trial investigation has been launched.

items.title: Zelenskyy warns that Russia is preparing new missile attack
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that Russia may launch a large-scale missile attack on the night of 16-17 November.

items.title: Sprecher der Luftwaffe: Russland bereitet neuen Angriff auf ukrainische Energieinfrastruktur vor
items.teaser: Die Ukraine erhält seit mehreren Tagen Informationen über die Vorbereitung eines neuen Angriffs auf Energieanlagen in der Ukraine, sagte der Sprecher der Luftwaffe, Juriij Ihnat, im ukrainischen Fernsehen.

items.title: Ukrainian pilot wipes out Russian assault-troop staging point with US-made precision GBU-39 bombs before next attack
items.teaser: A pilot of Ukraine’s 831st Myrhorod Tactical Aviation Brigade destroyed a site where Russian troops were massing for further strikes.

items.title: Russia’s energy war against Ukraine follows a pattern, Zelenskyy says. One oblast has taken 131 hits since September
items.teaser: In Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Russia’s 15 November strike cut power to parts of Dnipro and Kamianske, while Zaporizhzhia, hit the same day, had its power back by evening.

items.title: Dnipro left completely without power after Russian attack
items.teaser: The city of Dnipro has been completely left without electricity following an attack on energy facilities in the region.

items.title: "I've seen your face in the news!": Prince Harry meets Ukrainian soldier evacuated from his position by drone – video
items.teaser: At Superhumans Lviv, the Duke of Sussex spoke to Kostiantyn Vlasenko, whose rescue from a frontline position after losing his limbs made headlines around the world.

items.title: Blackout in Dnipro nach russischem Angriff
items.teaser: Die ganze Stadt Dnipro ist ohne Strom nach einem russischen Angriff auf Energieanlagen in der Region, teilt die DTEK-Gruppe via Telegram mit.

items.title: 'I haven't heard that' — Trump on Starshield restrictions after Zelensky's repeated warnings
items.teaser: The systematic speed restrictions affect the military's operation across the front line and in Russian-occupied territories.

items.title: Le Pen confirms plans to end financial aid to Ukraine if elected
items.teaser: Marine Le Pen, the presidential candidate of France's far-right National Rally party, has confirmed following a meeting with Ukraine's Ambassador Vadym Omelchenko that she intends to end financial assistance to Ukraine if she wins the 2027 presidential election.

items.title: Lithuania to accelerate Ukraine's EU accession during its 2027 presidency, but Kyiv must still pass reforms
items.teaser: Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kestutis Budrys told the Kyiv Independent that there are two main obstacles to his ambitious plans for Ukraine: the elections calendar across Europe in 2027, and Ukraine itself.

items.title: EU's top diplomat outlines Europe's demands on Russia: respect for Ukraine's borders and accountability for war crimes
items.teaser: The EU's foreign policy chief says Moscow must recognise Ukraine's borders, pay for war damage, return deported children and be held accountable for war crimes.

items.title: Ukraine is hitting Russian oil, petrochemicals, and strike bases, likely to make up for scarce interceptors, ISW says
items.teaser: The targets ranged from a Tatarstan refinery about 1,130 km from the front line to the airbase of jets that drop glide bombs on Ukrainian cities.

items.title: Power outages most severe in Dnipro, Kharkiv, Poltava and Zaporizhzhia – Ukrenergo
items.teaser: Russia has been systematically attacking Ukraine's energy infrastructure for more than a month, causing large-scale power outages in the east of the country.

items.title: Wildberries, Ozon, Banken und Schattenflotte: EU verhängt weiteres Sanktionspaket gegen Russland
items.teaser: Die Europäische Union hat am 16. November neue Sanktionen gegen zwölf Menschen und 101 Organisationen, die mit den Schlüsselsektoren der russischen Wirtschaft und dem Ölhandel von Russlands „Schattenflotte“ in Verbindung stehen, wie der Rat der EU-Länder mitteilt.

items.title: Sixth blackout in two weeks: Russia leaves almost half of Dnipro without power
items.teaser: Two people have been killed and eight others injured in Russian attacks on Dnipro. The strikes have damaged homes, businesses, vehicles and railway equipment across the city.

items.title: For Putin, foreign troops in Ukraine are unacceptable — unless they're fighting for Russia
items.teaser: Moscow repeated demands last week that no foreign soldier ever set foot in Ukraine, as a precondition to a peace deal. Meanwhile, it is recruiting Africans by the thousand to replace the Russians it can no longer afford. Moscow reiterated both in Abu Dhabi and to U.S. envoys that

items.title: Zelenskyy and Hungary's PM will meet by end of November, Ukrainian foreign minister says
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and his Hungarian counterpart Anita Orbán have discussed preparations for the leaders' meeting, as well as Ukraine's EU accession and bilateral cooperation.

items.title: Trump on restrictions on Starlink access in Ukraine: ‘I haven't heard that’
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has said he is unaware of any renewed restrictions on Ukraine's access to Starlink satellites.

items.title: Russia could launch 6,500 jet-powered Shahed-type drones at Ukraine in November, PM says
items.teaser: The increase follows a sharp rise in Russia’s use of jet-powered drones, which are faster and harder to intercept than older, propeller-driven drones.

items.title: EU Global Human Rights Sanctions Regime: Council lists four Haitian entities over serious human rights violations
items.teaser: The Council adopted restrictive measures against four Haitian criminal armed groups responsible for grave violations against children in armed conflict, including killings, sexual violence and the recruitment of children.

items.title: Russia’s FIMI and malicious cyber activities: Council imposes sanctions on 30 individuals and two entities
items.teaser: The Council adopted restrictive measures against 30 individuals and one entity responsible for actions on behalf of the Russian Federation undermining and threatening democracy, stability or security in the EU and some its Member States or in third countries. items.title: Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad: EU adds one entity and its founder to the sanctions list
items.teaser: The Council has added one individual and one entity to the sanctions list against Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, for their role in financing Hamas.

items.title: Trump claims he has not heard about Starlink restrictions in Ukraine
items.teaser: The US president says he has not heard about renewed restrictions on Starlink operations in Ukraine, which Ukrainian forces have reported experiencing.
